title: Hussein Askary: The War on Iran🇮🇷 is a WAR ON BRICS
text:
Hussein Askary: The War on Iran🇮🇷 is a WAR ON BRICS"

"'Trump already declared that he will not allow the BRICS nations to have any alternative system other than the dollar, and that US control in the world must remain. Joe Biden said this in 2022 when he visited Riyadh. He said, we will not leave the vacuum in this region. So there is a very clear intention not to allow the Global South nations to work together and prosper together."

"So we are back to the old British geopolitical idea of divide and conquer, divide and rule, where there are friends and there are enemies. And those who work with us, even in the Global South, they are our friends, they will be protected. Not anymore, as we have seen."

"But there is a deep philosophical difference here. When the Western powers, the colonial system, the imperialist system, believes in the zero-sum game, does not believe in win-win, that everybody could get a share of the pie. No, it's a pie, a small pie. And we want the biggest part. And we will give whomever we want, who is friendly to us, who obeys us, the rest of the pie."

"And this is what is very strange for people who are used to the zero-sum game imperialist, unipolar world idea, that no, we are the big guys, might makes right. I decide who eats and who does not eat.'"

"-Hussein Askary, Vice-Chairman of the Belt and Road Institute, and Author of 'Extending the New Silk Road to West Asia and Africa' on the latest episode of New Order."
